meta.title: RFQ bid: Quantity above the requested quantity

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Create one line item with the requested quantity of 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the bid.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's separate portal session while keeping the buyer session open.
Open the published RFQ's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Enter a vendor quantity of 12, above the requested quantity of 10.

args.because: Quantity cannot be greater than the mentioned quantity.

steps.note: Submit the over-quantity quote and require Procol to refuse it.

args.text: Quantity cannot be greater than the mentioned quantity.

steps.note: Verify the vendor portal displays the expected refusal message.
